title: Pain where pills can NOT reach
text: Pain where pills can NOT reach. These were a pain in the ass. Took me forever to install. There are bubble and wrinkles everywhere. This product is NOT forgiving at all. It does what its supposed to for privacy but it looks horrible inside.

product_metadata.title: rabbitgoo Window Privacy Film, Frosted Glass Window Film, Removable Opaque Sun Blocking Glass Covering Non-Adhesives Static Cling Vinyl Decals for Bathroom, Matte Pure, 35.4" x 78.7"
features: Enhanced Privacy: Our Matte Pure frosted glass window film provides 80% privacy level, making it an effective way to block unwanted views and ensure complete privacy in any room of your home or office. Perfect for use in bathrooms, living rooms, bedrooms, meeting rooms, sitting rooms, and more

Space Grid Backing Design: With the spaced grid lines on the protective backing film, you could cut the window privacy film to fit your window much easier and preciser. Also, there are also instructions of multilingual languages on the backing film to help your installation

Sun Light Rejection&Soften Strong Sunlight: This frosted sun blocking window film can reflect 84% UVA rays and 99% UVB rays back and prevent the furniture from fading. It could allow natural light in, ensuring your room enjoys a great privacy protection and soft sunshine in the meantime

Static Cling Design Without Sticky Glues : This frosted window cling privacy film is applied by static cling without sticky, harmful,and chemical glues. It could be easily removed without any adhesives left, and is reusable for multiply times

Installation Note: To peel off the clear backing film, please wet and twist one window film corner first, stick the small tape to the side of the clear backing film corner (there is a small sticky tape on each roll of window film you get), and then you are able to separate the window privacy film and the clear backing film easily
